result.title: ExCal: Optimization-Free Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Excess Calibration
result.comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026), Special Session on Intelligent Data Mining. 10 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables
result.summary: We introduce ExCal, a normal-only multivariate time series anomaly detector that combines raw state retrieval, a signal/derivative subspace, and robust statistics across temporal scales. Each expert map receives a high normality floor from the training prefix. During scoring, positive excess is retained, attenuated for broadly firing maps, and combined with a small rank term. The method fits reference memories and projections without gradient optimization or anomaly labels. Prevalence and ranks depend on the complete scored sequence, making inference batch and transductive rather than online. On 180 series from 17 TSB-AD-M families, ExCal obtains AUC-PR $0.421\pm0.37$ and VUS-PR $0.452\pm0.37$ over three seeds, ranking second among 24 methods. Holm-adjusted paired tests detect no significant difference from AxonAD or StreamVAE, which are the two leading non-pretrained methods on TSB-AD-M, on either primary metric, while finding significant positive differences against the other 21 baselines. A separate single-run probe over three series measures median model-wrapper time of $0.0662$ s. Ablations associate the largest primary-metric changes with raw retrieval and excess-magnitude preservation. The evaluated score is decomposable by expert, but its diagnostic utility and online suitability remain untested.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ExCal，一种仅用正常样本、无需梯度优化的多变量时序异常检测器，组合原始状态检索、信号/导数子空间与跨时间尺度稳健统计来构建可分解的异常分数。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为时序异常检测的检索式评分与统计校准，不涉及 VLM 内部视觉状态、latent 推理生成或轨迹监督；「excess calibration」对多专家图的加权虽可能与多源证据聚合类比，但线索过于泛化，未构成可核查的迁移点。
